reviewed_studies.revised_research_disposition: Low-priority comparator; zero useful crop locations and the historical discrete numerical audit failure remain unchanged.
Reopen the architecture rather than treating one failed readout as universal rejection; its later adapted model is now a high-priority candidate.
Reopen the adapted native candidate under owner-directed tradeoff comparison; original per-control zero-increase failure remains historical.
Retain as a second-view comparator: fewer false-original calls but more abstention; assess complementary cases.
Retain quality-conditioned calibration as a comparison; separate music gains from strong-noise losses.
Reopen near-baseline residual mapping: fewer false-original calls with modest loss of coverage; compare its full operating curve.
Retain the passing development result alongside the separate confirmation tradeoff; do not discard the decision-layer family.
Reopen: 823 versus 761 correct conclusions, with 38 versus 35 false AI and 52 versus 39 false-original calls. Keep the noisy-AI failure visible.
Reopen as a low-false-alarm and probability-score alternative; retain source/speaker grouping correction.
Retain nonlinear and quality combinations for comparative calibration; quality-only remains low priority.
Reopen full-vector calibration and its projection control; compare probability quality, coverage and new/lost cases.
Reopen multilayer features as a complementary view; lower proper-score error and fewer false alarms merit comparison despite missed calls.
Prioritize combined features for noise/music comparisons; overlapping-speech weakness must remain separately reported.
Keep combined separation as a cautious secondary comparator; standalone separation remains low priority because almost all calls abstain.
Reopen pooled/context-specific variants together; fewer false alarms and fewer AI detections are a tradeoff, not an automatic rejection.
Retain both context/focus views as sensitivity comparators while exposing their large human-highlight burden.
Lower priority in this panel because origin ranking and both error directions worsen; no architecture-wide rejection.
Reopen length-specific/two-detector calibration: lower Brier and false alarms with more misses need a balanced comparison.
Reopen all eight scoped alternatives; an extra useful detection with an extra false alarm is a tradeoff, not automatic failure.
Prioritize the interval head as complementary evidence. Actual fixed two-model unions are measured in this review.
Reopen AEGIS ranking and calibration under multi-domain comparison. CakeLens remains a runtime-qualified candidate needing a cohort test; licensing exclusions remain.
Keep the qualified sequence method and normalized/raw alternatives in shared comparisons; preserve rollback.
Keep as a low-priority comparator; distinguish the measured all-inconclusive mapping from a universal architectural rejection.
Keep the locally integrated appearance cue as a strong reference, with zero authorship-confidence weight until specific evidence supports it.
Reopen calibrated combinations for complementary localization comparisons; compare against the strong raw appearance reference, not only crop-only.
Retain the ordinary-edit limitation: detecting an appearance transition is not proof of AI authorship. Broaden controls rather than remove the cue.
Retain the small context gain as a candidate component; compare extra localized swaps, false flags and added cost rather than all-or-nothing adoption.
Reopen as a sensitive review cue: 31/32 versus 26/32 edits, with 24/56 versus 12/56 ordinary flags. Do not call audiovisual mismatch proof of AI.

scope: Reconsider research dispositions, not rewrite old experiments or declare all candidates successful.
